title: 第1章 加点面板第2章 北源李氏
slug: 全族助我加点我举族飞升天界
content_zh:
“我～这是在哪？”
一个满头银发且面容苍老的老人，盘坐在团蒲之上。
他看着四周昏暗但有几处散发着荧光，但并不像是在他的房间当中，这让他一时之间有些失神！
陌生的环境，模糊的视线，使他心中浮现许多疑问！
没多久，当他抬起双手，看着自己这双枯槁且全是褶皱的手，更是彻底懵了。
若是他没记错的话，他自己应该还是一个年轻人才对。
但此时却是更像一个行将就木的老人！
准确来说就是一个老人！
还没等他想明白其中缘由！
突然间，一阵剧烈的疼痛感从脑海之中传来。
强烈的痛楚，使得他不得不使用他那枯槁的双手，捂着自己的脑袋。
他的嘴巴因为疼痛而叫出了声来。
“啊……吸～疼死我了！”
但没有坚持多久，他便彻底昏睡了过去！
半天之后，昏睡过去的老人缓缓苏醒过来，但他的眼神之中依旧有些迷茫。
“我～我这是穿越了？”
一股陌生的记忆从他的脑海之中涌现出来。
将记忆梳理片刻之后，他终于确定了一件事。
是的，他叫李北玄，穿越到了一个与他同名同姓的垂暮老人身上。
记忆中的原主因为寿元将尽，便选择强行突破境界，最后一命呜呼。

也不知道是何原因，让他死而复生，但灵魂却换成了他！
原主乃是北源李氏老祖！
其实也就是一个破落家族的老祖而已。
全族上下除他之外，也就一共109位族人！
在这方强者为尊，弱肉强食的世界中，他们小小李家这点实力根本不够看。
在他的记忆中，这是一个蛮荒世界，强大的修士不仅能够飞天遁地，开山断海，更是有着悠长的寿元。
修炼到极致，可羽化而登仙！
但这是强者的世界！
他北源李氏，不过就是一个艰难求生的小族而已。
“北源李氏～老祖？”李北玄喃喃自语。
此时的他已是149岁高龄，原主先前是先天境圆满修为，因为强行突破失败遭受到反噬。
content_en:
"I~where is this?"
An old man with silver hair and an old face sat cross-legged on a tuanfu.
He looked around at the dim surroundings, but there were a few places that were glowing with fluorescence, but it didn't look like he was in his room, which made him a little distracted for a moment!
The unfamiliar environment and blurred vision made many questions arise in his mind!
Not long after, when he raised his hands and looked at his withered and wrinkled hands, he was completely confused.
If he remembered correctly, he himself should still be a young man.
But at this time, he looks more like a dying old man!
An old man to be precise!
Before he could figure out the reason!
Suddenly, a sharp pain came from his mind.
The intense pain forced him to use his withered hands to cover his head.
His mouth cried out in pain.
"Ah...suck it~it hurts me so much!"
But he didn't last long before he fell asleep completely!
Half a day later, the old man who had fallen asleep slowly woke up, but his eyes were still a little confused.
"I~I've traveled through time?"
A strange memory emerged from his mind.
After sorting through his memories for a moment, he finally determined one thing.
Yes, his name is Li Beixuan, and he time-traveled into the body of an old man with the same name and surname as him.
Because the original owner in the memory was about to expire, he chose to forcefully break through the realm and finally died.
I don’t know why he came back from the dead, but his soul was replaced by his!
The original owner is the ancestor of the Li family in Beiyuan!
In fact, he is just the ancestor of a run-down family.
Apart from him, there are only 109 clan members in the whole clan!
In this world where the strong are respected and the weak eat the strong, the strength of their little Li family is simply not enough.
In his memory, this was a wild world. Powerful monks could not only fly to the sky and escape from the earth, break mountains and cut seas, but also had long lifespans.
If you practice to the extreme, you can transform into an immortal!
But this is the world of the strong!
The Beiyuan Li clan is just a small clan struggling to survive.
"Beiyuan Li family~ancestor?" Li Beixuan muttered to himself.
At this time, he was already 149 years old. The original owner had previously achieved perfect cultivation in the Xiantian realm, but suffered backlash due to the failure of his forced breakthrough.
